subject: Request: Cohort webinar promo top-up + 30-day trial extension
messages:
From: BrightConf Partner Success <partner-success@brightconf.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: BrightConf Dec cohort — request for additional promo codes & trial extension

Hi Monica / Marissa,

Quick note — our December cohort had to be pushed by two weeks because one of our headline speakers had to reschedule. Attendance is lower than expected for the original registration window and the marketing team asked if we can:

- Top up promo codes for the rescheduled session (approx 150 additional attendee codes).
- Extend the standard 14-day trial to 30 days for these attendees to give them time to evaluate after the session.

We can absorb distribution and reporting on our side; we just need Redwood to issue the codes and confirm the trial window. We need the codes in hand by Monday 21st to include in our reminder email on Wed 22nd.

Metrics so far: 420 registered, expected 220 live attendees after reschedule. If possible we'd like 100 full-trial codes and 50 smaller credit bundles (e.g., $75 in credits) so we can offer choice to attendees.

Attachments: draft_map_for_brightconf.pdf (high level agenda / attendee timing)

Appreciate any help here — let me know required approvals or cost.

Best,
Emma Torres
Partnerships | BrightConf Events
emma@acmeanalytics.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: BrightConf Partner Success <partner-success@brightconf.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: BrightConf Dec cohort — request for additional promo codes & trial extension

Emma — thanks for the context and the timeline. I'm looping in Marissa (sales lead on this partnership) and Neha (growth ops) to confirm credit allocation and the trial extension policy. A few quick clarifying Qs so we can speed approvals:

- Confirmed split you want: 100 full 30-day trials + 50 $75 credit bundles?
- Are the attendees predominantly new accounts (first-time Redwood users) or existing customers?
- Do you need unique codes per registrant or a single redeemable link?

We can move fast if sales signs off on the credit spend. Marissa — can you confirm approval to allocate ~150 promo entitlements and whether we should charge a nominal partner fee or treat this as a co-marketing credit? If approved, Neha, can Growth Ops produce the codes and a simple redemption tracker CSV by Friday 18th?

I'll draft a quick mutual action plan for signatures once we align.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Partner Programs (Customer Partnerships)
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: BrightConf Dec cohort — request for additional promo codes & trial extension

Monica / Neha — reviewed. Approve allocating the 150 entitlements under a co-marketing credit. Proposed approach:

- 100 accounts: 30-day full trial (standard onboarding entitlement).
- 50 accounts: $75 credit bundles (applied as one-time promo credits).
- Partner to provide attendee list 48 hours before distribution.

Operational notes / conditions:
- Promo codes to expire 60 days from issue; redemption limited to new accounts only (we can't extend trials for existing paying customers).
- Partner to include Redwood branding in reminder and follow-up emails per the co-marketing brief.
- Finance sign-off required for the estimated cost (see estimate in invoice_estimate_credits.xlsx).

Neha — please generate the promo_code_list.csv and attach the standard promo_policy_summary.pdf when you send. Vivek — flagging for awareness of the co-marketing commitment; if finance needs additional sign-off, let us know and I'll route.

Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships, Americas
Redwood Inference

All — workflow status and next steps. Per Marissa's sign-off we will proceed with the allocation under co-marketing. Deliverables timeline: 

- Promo codes: I will generate 150 unique codes and prepare promo_code_list.csv by EOD Monday 21st.
- Promo policy: attached summary (promo_policy_summary.pdf stub) and brief on redemption rules.
- Finance: attached estimate (invoice_estimate_credits.xlsx stub). Finance indicated low-risk but requires the partner list prior to code activation.

Partner action items for Emma / BrightConf:
- Provide final attendee list (email + company) 48 hours prior to distribution (i.e., by Nov 19th? sorry, meant Dec 19th).
- Confirm whether you want codes embedded in unique links or a bulk CSV (we can support both).

Attachment(s): promo_policy_summary.pdf (stub), invoice_estimate_credits.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — will follow up with the CSV once generated.
